output.content:
Marvell did **not disclose a standalone dollar revenue figure for custom AI silicon** in Q3 fiscal 2026. The company reported that its custom business declined sequentially because of demand lumpiness, while indicating that custom revenue would rebound in Q4. [[1]] [[2]] 

For context, Marvell’s total Q3 FY2026 revenue was **$2.075 billion**, and data-center revenue was **$1.518 billion** (73% of consolidated revenue), with management attributing the data-center performance to AI-driven interconnect and custom-silicon demand. [[3]] [[2]]
